reason: I'd install the free version, my kid would play it for a week like every other app, and then it gets deleted. YouTube already teaches letters for free, so I'm not paying 25 thousand a month for something that will be gone in two weeks.
objection: My child gets bored of every app within a week, so a monthly subscription is money thrown away.
would_change_my_mind: If after a month of the free version my child still asks for it on their own and I can see in the parent area that they actually learned letters.
